title: Sharpe 排行有數字時要標明是短樣本：避免把 12.8 看成真實績效
hosted_verification_note: Verified locally via Vitest unit/component/i18n tests, TypeScript application and Agora typechecks, contract drift checks, and ESLint. Hosted environment was not touched.

acceptance_criteria.1_sharpe_leaders_with_rows_shows_localiz:
verified: When b.kind === 'sharpe-leaders' and rows are non-empty, RankingBlocks renders

{t("mgmt.pulse.sharpeShortSampleCaption")}

below the row
    ('20 日滾動、樣本短，僅供參考' in zh-TW, 'Rolling 20-day short sample; for reference only' in en-US).
acceptance_criteria.2_caption_absent_when_empty_and_building: verified: When b.kind === 'sharpe-leaders' and rows are empty, RankingBlocks takes the empty branch and renders only t('mgmt.pulse.sharpeBuildingHistory') ('樣本累積中：至少需要 10 個交易日的日報酬才會計算 Sharpe' in zh-TW, 'Building history: Sharpe needs at least 10 daily returns' in en-US); the short-sample caption is not rendered.
acceptance_criteria.3_sharpe_values_row_order_and_links_unch: verified: All rows in b.rows render through the existing <ul>/<li>/<Link> and formatPulseValue(r.metricValue) markup without filtering, reordering, or altering values (verified with 15.6, 12.8, 9.3).
acceptance_criteria.4_other_ranking_blocks_show_no_caption: verified: Ranking blocks with b.kind !== 'sharpe-leaders' (such as 'pnl-leaders') do not render mgmt.pulse.sharpeShortSampleCaption whether populated or empty.
acceptance_criteria.5_focused_tests_i18n_parity_and_typechec: verified: Focused tests in src/management/pages/oversight/TradingPulsePage.test.tsx (8 tests), src/lib/v5/management/__tests__/i18nParity.test.ts (10 tests), npm run typecheck:app, and npm run typecheck:agora all pass.
acceptance_criteria.6_evidence_records_exact_commands_and_re: verified: Exact commands, exit codes, and test counts are recorded in verification below.

typecheck.command: npm run typecheck:app && npm run typecheck:agora
